caption: An overloaded power drill is run hard, and small sparks flicker through the vents on its motor housing.

sa.check: The drill is run hard: it is pressed into work or held under load.
Small sparks flicker through the vents on its motor housing.
The sparks are inside the housing, seen through the vent slots.
The sparks flicker while the drill runs.

pc.expect: The sparks are visible only inside the vents while the motor runs, flickering; they stop when the trigger is released and the motor winds down.
pc.fail: Sparks keep flickering in the vents after the trigger is released and the chuck has stopped; or sparks come out of the housing and fly across the room; or the vents glow steadily like a lamp; or sparks appear at the chuck rather than the vents.

pc.expect: One drill with its vents in fixed places; the sparks leave nothing behind.
pc.fail: Glowing dots stay on the housing after the motor stops; or the vents change number or place; or a second drill appears; or the drill vanishes.

pc.expect: Any spark fragment that escapes the vents falls and goes dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: Escaping sparks rise and gather above the drill; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the bench for the rest of the clip.
pc.precondition: Sparks are seen leaving the vents.

pc.expect: The chuck and bit spin about the drill's axis while the trigger is held; the drill body is held steady.
pc.fail: The bit wobbles off its axis or bends while turning; or the chuck turns while the bit stays still; or the whole drill body spins with the bit.

pc.expect: The drill keeps its shape; the housing stays whole and the bit passes only into the work.
pc.fail: The housing melts or bulges; or the bit passes through the work and the bench beneath as if through air; or the drill changes shape; or a hand passes through the drill.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The drill's colour and markings and the bench stay the same.
pc.fail: The drill changes colour; or its markings change; or items on the bench rearrange.
